notes.title: 7/2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a few days since we've posted an update log for our nightly-ish bug fix builds... here's a list of most of what's been addressed recently!


 We've taken a pass on achievements, some of which were incorrectly triggering (or not triggering) previously. We also got approval from Steam for more achievements, so in the coming weeks we'll be filling in some we had to cut before launch!
 Remaining bugs affecting the garden and garden items have been dealt with. If you had issues with your garden refusing to grow or difficulties with item quantities or spores from Gnome Depot, then give it another try.
 Various crashes from around the game have been fixed.
 An ending wasn't being triggered correctly previously, and should now be gettable.
 Clicking whilst lines with a 'typewriter effect' would previously cause the line to be skipped, now it should correctly complete the animation on the text instead.
 Controller support has been improved for combat events
 The code managing first-person dungeon navigation has been refactored, hopefully resulting in a more stable experience. (This is an ongoing effort, with more improvements coming in the future as well!)
 ...and a couple of other little things we're forgetting about, I'm sure~


Thanks, as always, for playing! If you run into anything unexpected, feel free to let us know through our bug submission forum (or the pinned topic in the Steam discussion forum).

notes.title: 6/29 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Over the past few days, we've released a couple patches that should help with a variety of bugs (including some work on persistent story events, further fixes for garden growth related issues, and a crash during a witch confrontation)

If you run into anything unexpected, feel free to let us know through our bug submission forum (or the pinned topic in the Steam discussion forum).

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: 6/26 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We've just pushed a new build that should fix a variety of bugs (particularly related to the garden, though there were several achievement and combat related issues addressed as well).

Were you personally inconvenienced by these bugs, or any other? Are you owed repentance? Simply tell the password-doorman GIVEMESPORES in order to receive an apology. Much simpler than most things in life, no?

notes.title: 6/22 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Welcome to Day #2 patch notes!

Today, we've fixed some crashes involving thievery, mushroomy discussions, and an already buggy fight (if you catch our drift) along with a few minor UI tweaks.

As always, thanks for playing! If you run into any issues, please submit them to our bug report form~

notes.title: Day One Patch Notes
notes.content:
We just launched a new build fixing some combat soft locks, minor UI issues, and an infinite loop when playing as certain girls.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Ah, can you feel that? Spring is in the air! 🌱

Toads croaking, fragrant flowers, and a piping-hot video game almost ready to emerge from hibernation...!
The full version of Mushroom Musume will release on June 20th!~ 🍄💖

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44670946/f2ac22f8ce2cf494faa82965255c7548bcd97c7a.png

If you haven't already, be sure to wishlist today!

PS: In the past month we've also released a few updates to the demo, if you missed it! We fixed a few bugs, tweaked some UIs, and improved controller support.

notes.title: Check Out Mushroom Musume at Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hot Off the Presses!

While the team is hard at work finishing up some expanded content for the full release, we've also taken the time to whip up a new build that everyone can enjoy just in time for Next Fest (live now~)

This new build features a variety of small bug fixes, as well as an updated Settings menu (with new display options) to allow for maximum comfort while rearing mushroom children.

Stay tuned for news about the full release... We've been holding off on officially announcing the release date until things are mostly ready, but I think we're on track for our internal goal at least!

notes.title: Bug Fixes and UI Adjustments, Oh My!
notes.content:
Have you ever been tending to your daughter, only to notice that something wasn't quite right? Good news! A new build of the Mushroom Musume demo has now been published

Featuring...

Some UI elements have been updated to clarify certain parts of the game design.
Bug fixes (part 1): We located a few places in the code that were causing issues and were able to fix them.
Bug fixes (part 2): The pet bugs have been improved!
A number of typos have been identified and corrected.


https://i.imgur.com/YKRjJG1.gif
Some icons correspond to certain stats... now that stat is highlighted when relevant!

https://i.imgur.com/WuQH983.gif
I'm being so serious about these bugs right now

🐛 If you ever run into a (computer) bug while playing, feel free to submit it to our bug report form! (You can also send us pictures of insects if you want, I guess...)
